findings.title: coverage ratchet baseCommit only advanced
findings.detail: baseCommit is updated from 9c7c5c6… to a64b8db… while highWaterPct stays 94.37. No coverage report or test run is in this chunk to show the new base is valid or that coverage was re-measured. Ratchet state changes without evidence are not verifiable as correct.

findings.title: capture-frames uses fixed sleep not ready signal
findings.detail: After goto(networkidle), the script uses page.waitForTimeout(400) before screenshot instead of waiting on a real ready signal (e.g. image load / decoded). Fixed sleeps are unreliable and can capture unloaded media; the comment admits the intent was to wait for image decode but implements a sleep.

findings.title: legal substance floor raised without content proof in chunk
findings.detail: Test thresholds jump from >=3 sections / >=150 words to >=14 sections / >=1400 words for terms and privacy. This chunk only changes the test expectations and home/examples i18n keys; it does not show the expanded en.pages.terms / en.pages.privacy body. Cannot verify the new floor is actually met by locale content from this patch alone — FAIL until content is proven.

findings.title: FeaturesStep refactor is behavior-preserving
findings.detail: resolveFeatureSelection is rewritten from a ternary to explicit if-branches with comments. Logic is equivalent: kept if any valid ids; empty array if user cleared all; else defaults when prior ids went stale. No defect found in this change.

findings.title: examples i18n keys added without usage proof

This chunk does not show the Examples page or forge-error UI wiring those keys. Keys alone do not prove the card-catalog UI, filter empty state, or forge failure panel exist and use them.

findings.title: DECISION.md is process record not product proof
findings.detail: DECISION.md records Option 3 Card catalog as chosen and requires real gate numbers in 'What it does' breakdowns. A decision doc is not implementation; cannot treat this as evidence that the live examples page implements card catalog, filters, or measured stats.

findings.title: gallery references PNG assets not in this patch
findings.detail: gallery.html src attributes point at option-*-{light,dark}-{375,1280}.png frames. The capture script and gallery HTML are present; the binary PNGs are not shown in this text diff. Cannot verify screenshots exist or match the three structural options from the patch text alone.

findings.title: canForgePrd A1 gate is fail-closed and tested
findings.detail: canForgePrd now refuses when entityList is empty and deriveEntities yields nothing, aligning forge readiness with generatePrd A1. job.test.ts adds cases for fragment titles and zero-entity prompts. Verified in this chunk.

findings.title: Wizard test prompt fix for entity derivation
findings.detail: Base prompt changed so domain nouns derive; fragment and no-entity tests isolate A6 and A1. Logic is coherent from the visible tests.

findings.title: Internal PRD contradiction: entities listed but storage mode none
findings.detail: The fixture PRD frontmatter and prose name domain entities UptimeCheck and StatusPage, user stories for browse/search/detail/CRUD, and API files uptime_checks.ts / status_pages.ts with list/create/get signatures, while simultaneously asserting data storage = none, no domain DDL, no domain CRUD tables, and Data: None (stateless). That is a self-contradictory characterization artifact: either empty-entities means no domain work (and the entity/API stories should be absent) or entities imply simple storage and DDL. As written the fixture cannot validly characterize either mode and would teach the generator conflicting contracts. FAIL — contradiction is explicit in the single-line JSON body.

findings.title: Self-check claims DDL for entities while DDL is none
findings.detail: PRD Self-Check marks "DDL present for every entity (or explicit none)" as passed, and separately grades 14/16, while §7.2 says no D1 domain schema and API surface has no domain CRUD — yet §7.2 also lists entity schemas, list/create/get handlers, and components for UptimeCheck/StatusPage. The empty-entities fixture is not a coherent golden sample of "entities: present, auth: false, storage: none"; it embeds the conflict rather than isolating empty-entity behavior. FAIL.

findings.title: JSON fixture missing trailing newline
findings.detail: Diff marks "No newline at end of file". Minor style/tooling hygiene issue; many linters and POSIX text rules expect a final newline. Not a functional defect by itself but an avoidable noise in a characterization fixture.

findings.title: Generated schema is generic title/description, not domain fields
findings.detail: The characterization fixture's generated PRD DDL and schemas model every entity (shifts, employees, locations, swap_requests, overtime_logs) as generic title/description rows rather than domain fields implied by the prompt (roles, times, swaps, overtime approvals, multi-location coverage). The same generic pattern appears in API examples ("rem_01", "Scheduled care task"). This is a real fidelity defect visible in the patch: domain entities are named but product shape is not characterized, and the PRD self-check even records an unmatched prompt-fidelity item (15/16).

findings.title: MVP scope contradicts itself within the same PRD body
findings.detail: Early sections state MVP is F1–F5 only (Introduction, Success Outcome, user stories), while the Initial build prompt and later checklist require F1–F7 features and F1–F13 tests. That internal inconsistency is explicit in the fixture content and would mislead a builder following the document.

findings.title: PRD self-check admits prompt fidelity failure
findings.detail: Section 14 marks prompt fidelity unchecked: unmatched requirements truncated mid-sentence ("employee ro…"). Grade 15/16 documents that the long multi-entity prompt was not fully captured. For a characterization fixture of long-prompt-many-entities, that is a concrete quality failure of the generated artifact, not truncation of the review.

findings.title: Fixture PRD truncates brand/title
findings.detail: The generated fixture still uses the broken truncated product name "App to Remind You When Your" (slug app-to-remind-you-when-your) derived from an incomplete title parse of the prompt about dog grooming reminders. That is user-facing product copy in a characterization fixture and is not a coherent product name. If the PRD pipeline was supposed to produce complete titles, this fixture documents a still-broken outcome rather than a fixed one.

findings.title: Pet example IDs reuse rem_ prefix
findings.detail: In the Pet API example contracts embedded in the fixture, response examples use id "rem_01" for pets (e.g. GET/POST /api/pets examples). That is a copy-paste defect from the Reminder examples; pet ids should use a pet_ (or similar) prefix. Leaving rem_ in Pet contracts mis-documents the interface and can mislead implementers.

findings.title: Definition of Done only asserts emission, not substance
findings.detail: buildDefinitionOfDone() emits a large checklist including G7 (two-run measurements) and related fail-closed rules, and DEFINITION_OF_DONE_HEADING is only for a self-check that the block string appears. From this patch alone there is no test that every DONE_CHECKLIST_SECTIONS row is rendered, that evidence strings are non-empty where required, or that selfCheck fails when a row is missing. Emission of a heading is not proof the checklist content is correct or enforced.

findings.title: Standard features tests do not prove implementation
findings.detail: New tests only assert that buildFeatures always emits MVP Search and filter and Ask the assistant features with GIVEN/WHEN/THEN acceptance and /api/assistant in integration tests. That verifies PRD feature generation strings, not that any app implements search UI, assistant route, grounding, or error states. If the author claim is that apps now get these capabilities, this chunk only proves the PRD template lists them.

findings.title: Empty-entity standard features still claim domain search
findings.detail: Test expects Search and filter and Ask the assistant even when entities are []. Without seeing buildFeatures, it is likely the names still include a domain entity or generic "records" label; if they do not, acceptance criteria referencing entity list/search become vacuous for entity-less apps. The test only checks name prefixes, not that acceptance criteria remain coherent when there is no entity.

findings.title: result view idle state treated as forge error
findings.detail: When view is 'result' and forgeResult.status is 'idle', the UI renders the same forge error banner and recovery actions as a real failure. Idle is not an error: after reset() sets status to 'idle' and returns to wizard, this path is unreachable in normal flow, but any accidental setView('result') with idle status (or a future refactor that keeps result view while idle) will show a false error. Prefer rendering null or navigating away rather than equating idle with failure.

findings.title: capability verify still points at search.spec.ts only
findings.detail: After adding isSearchFilter with its own verify command (collection-search.spec.ts), capability features still use `npx playwright test tests/search.spec.ts`. Capability slices are not the standard search feature; reusing search.spec.ts as the default verify for every capability is a leftover coupling that can greenwash slices that never implement search, or force unrelated capability work to invent a search e2e. Should use a capability-specific or generic suite, not the search-named path now reserved for the standard search feature.

findings.title: assistant grounding unit test is unverifiable as specified
findings.detail: tests.unit lists `assistant_groundsInAppData_notGeneralKnowledge`. That name asserts product behavior (grounding in app data vs general knowledge) that a pure unit test cannot honestly prove without a mocked model plus fixture rows and a content assertion policy. The PRD now forces this as a standard feature and self-check, but the unit slot overclaims: real proof belongs in integration/e2e (also listed). Risk: generators emit a vacuous unit test that always passes, satisfying the PRD checklist without verifying grounding.

findings.title: primaryTable fallback may emit invalid verify paths
findings.detail: isSearchFilter verify uses `tests/${primaryTable || 'collection'}-search.spec.ts`. When primaryTable is empty, the command targets collection-search.spec.ts; when primaryTable is set to a multi-word or non-slug form elsewhere, the path may not match what the generator will actually create. Combined with features.ts collectionLabel falling back to 'records', slice verify, feature e2e names, and scaffold file names can diverge. Not proven broken without the full generator, but the triple of 'records' / 'collection' / primaryTable is inconsistent within this patch alone.

findings.title: Definition-of-Done self-check strength not fully visible in chunk
findings.detail: hasDefinitionOfDone requires DEFINITION_OF_DONE_HEADING plus every DONE_CHECKLIST_SECTIONS row id as `**id**` in markdown. That is a solid anti-stub pattern. The patch then truncates mid-items list at gate; whether definition-of-done is wired into the items array and into the overall pass aggregate is not fully shown in the visible portion after the offload cut. From what is present, search-feature and assistant-feature items are added correctly. No explicit fail on incomplete wiring can be proven from the visible lines only—do not pass the full selfCheck change as verified beyond the visible hasSearchFeature/hasAssistantFeature and hasDefinitionOfDone computations.

findings.title: Home forgeResult error path improves fail-closed UX
findings.detail: generatePrd failures are caught, including UnresolvedPrdError, and surface ErrorBanner with back-to-wizard / new actions instead of leaving prd null with a silent empty result. That matches fail-closed product rules for the forge flow. Verified in the visible success/error branches.

findings.title: Search and assistant forced into every PRD features list
findings.detail: Standard search/filter and assistant features are always pushed with mvp:true, acceptance, and test slots, and rationaleForFeature labels them for fe-search-present / fe-assistant-present. slices.ts excludes them from entity table minting and assigns API/UI/db guidance. Intent is clear and consistent across features + slices + selfCheck regex on §8.
